[contact omitted] Mikael Baker Thursday, September 22, 2022 at 1:25:15 AM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [opaque block] [opaque block] [contact omitted] Mikheil Benidze
Cc: [contact omitted] Leah Kaplan, [contact omitted] Lisa Kovack [opaque block] [contact omitted] [opaque block] [contact omitted],

Kateryna Kruk
Dear Misha,
Thank you for inviting us. It would be great to meet with Kateryna, and I will join the Friday meeting.
Best,
Mikael
Mikael Baker
Senior Digital Development and Cybersecurity Advisor (DDA), USAID/Georgia
U.S. AGENCY FOR INTERNATIONAL DEVELOPMENT
[opaque block]
[opaque block]
USAID.gov | [contact omitted] | [contact omitted] | [link omitted]
On Tue, Sep 20, 2022 at 5:22 PM Mikheil Benidze < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Dear all,
As communicated to USAID colleagues earlier, Meta's regional manager for Public Policy - Kateryna Kruk (cc-ed) is
visiting Tbilisi this week. We are helping Kateryna in arranging meetings with key stakeholders and she would like to
have an opportunity to meet with the US Embassy and USAID representatives. Issues of electoral integrity,
information integrity, disinformation and hybrid threats are the key topics Kateryna deals with and has a great deal
of experience overall.
The meeting will take place on Friday, September 23 at 15:30, at the meeting room in our office - C [opaque block]
[opaque block] (InOffice office building, behind the Soros Foundation building and driveway entrance right next to Rooms
Hotel).
Please let us know if you are able to make it.
Thank you and best regards,
Misha
Mikheil Benidze
Chief of Party
USAID Information Integrity Program
[opaque block]
